summary: Frontend-only regression of the Apple/Spotify visual redesign against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Exercised every route on desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 using real seeded data. Login (invalid creds, password/magic-link toggle, help panel) OK. Admin login as thetruth219@gmail.com/FisherAdmin#2026 → /dashboard renders family-feature + collection grid + quicklinks. All sidebar-nav-* links present; every route (/reunion, /family-business, /payments, /meetings, /documents, /contact, /admin, /members, /disbursements, /my-statements, /account) mounts with correct page-title and 0 horizontal overflow at 1920x800. Documents search (documents-search) filters correctly (6→documents-empty on 'zzz'→6 after clear). Disbursements ledger shows 4 seeded rows; disbursement-create-button opens portal dialog, Escape closes it; audit dialog opens and audit-close-button closes it. Edit-mode toggle enables edit-mode-banner on /documents. Members admin renders 3 member rows; edit-member-modal opens and edit-member-close (X) closes it. Account profile block visible. Mobile 390: mobile-menu-button opens the Sheet, mobile-nav-documents navigates, Escape closes. /disbursements at 390px shows 0 overflow (stacked labeled rows), members and contact 0 overflow. Logout works. Victoria (member) login: admin/members/disbursements sidebar links correctly hidden by role. Victoria hitting /disbursements returns 403 from API. /auth/verify without token shows the missing-token error copy 'This sign-in link is missing its token.' Did NOT create/edit any live disbursement, member, or contact records to avoid emails; did not modify credentials or timezone. No refactors made to production code.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844 the decorative SVG (.family-artwork.art-green.home-feature-art, .art-orbit, .art-petals) extends past the viewport (right=435 vs innerWidth=390). 8 overflow offenders detected on dashboard mobile. Body scroll isn't broken by overflow-x hidden ancestors, but the artwork visually clips oddly at the right edge. Consider max-width:100%, overflow:hidden on .home-feature-art, or hiding artwork below sm.

integration_issues.issue: Route still mounts and fires API calls that return 403 (visible in console) rather than being blocked/redirected client-side by ProtectedRoute. URL stays on /disbursements with an empty/broken page. Consider adding role gate in ProtectedRoute (or redirect to /my-statements) for admin routes.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The visual-editing runtime injects <span data-ve-dynamic style='display:contents'> inside <option> elements for the members select. It's a console warning only (dialog still works and select is usable) but pollutes logs and can cause subtle hydration mismatches. If this warning is being generated by the emergent visual-edit instrumentation only in preview builds, it can be ignored in prod; otherwise wrap the option text with a plain string.

action_items: Constrain the FamilyArtwork SVG inside .home-feature-art at <=430px viewports (overflow:hidden on the container or scale/clip the SVG) so it doesn't overflow at 390px.
Add role-based redirect in ProtectedRoute for admin-only routes (/disbursements, /members, /admin) so members are redirected instead of seeing a page that just 403s in the background.
Investigate the '<span> in <option>' hydration warning inside the disbursement create dialog member select (visual-editor dynamic-expression wrapper).
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx renders admin sidebar links conditionally (good) but no client-side redirect for admins-only pages — API 403 is the only guard.
Dashboard mobile artwork uses absolute-positioned SVG that isn't bounded by container's box → causes overflow. Add overflow:hidden to .home-feature-art.
Visual-editor injecting <span> children into <option> elements is React-invalid; should be feature-flagged off for dynamic list mapping over <select><option> patterns.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all functional flows pass; 1 medium visual overflow + 1 minor role-gate polish)

rca of the issue: Dashboard mobile overflow: .home-feature-art (SVG container inside .home-feature card) lacks overflow constraint; the FamilyArtwork SVG (viewBox scaled) renders wider than the 390px viewport because parent uses a min-width or absolute positioning that isn't reflowed for mobile. Fix: add `overflow:hidden; max-width:100%` on .home-feature-art or wrap SVG with `preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid slice'` plus a bounded width in App.css at the mobile breakpoint. Member 403 flash: ProtectedRoute only checks auth, not role — add a `roles=['admin']` prop and redirect members to /my-statements before mounting the admin page.
